privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Tekizz, protecting your personal data is a priority. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have regarding your data.
privacy.collectionContent: We collect information you provide when creating your account (first name, last name, email address, username) as well as progression data generated during your games (scores, statistics, game history). Anonymized technical data about your browser and device may also be collected for diagnostic purposes.
privacy.usageContent: Your data is used to operate the platform, display your statistics and leaderboard ranking, improve the gaming experience, and communicate important service updates. We do not use your data for advertising purposes.
privacy.sharingContent: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. Some data may be shared with our technical service providers (hosting, OAuth authentication) solely for the purpose of delivering the service.
privacy.cookiesContent: We use your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your language preferences and session. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
privacy.securityContent: We apply standard security measures: password encryption (bcrypt), HTTPS communication, and OAuth authentication through trusted providers (Google, GitHub). No passwords are stored in plain text.
privacy.rightsContent: You can view, modify, or delete your data at any time from your account settings. For any request regarding your personal data, contact us at: privacy@tekizz.com.
privacy.changesContent: We may update this policy from time to time. In case of significant changes, you will be notified by email or via an in-app notification.
privacy.contactContent: For any questions about this privacy policy, contact us at: privacy@tekizz.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Tekizz. By using our platform, you agree to these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.
terms.acceptanceContent: By creating an account or using Tekizz, you confirm that you have read and accepted these terms. If you do not agree, you may not use our service.
terms.serviceContent: Tekizz is an interactive learning platform offering quiz games (QCM, Smatch) on technology topics. The service is provided free of charge in its current state and may evolve over time.
terms.accountContent: You must create an account to access all features. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. You agree to provide accurate information when registering.
terms.useContent: You agree to use Tekizz only for lawful purposes. In particular, you may not automate interactions with the platform, attempt to manipulate rankings, or exploit technical vulnerabilities.
terms.ipContent: Platform content (questions, design, code) is the property of Tekizz or its contributors. You are granted a personal, non-commercial right to use it. Unauthorized reproduction or distribution is prohibited.
terms.liabilityContent: Tekizz is provided without warranty of any kind. We shall not be liable for service interruptions, data loss, or indirect damages related to the use of the platform.
terms.terminationContent: You may delete your account at any time from your settings. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate an account in case of violation of these terms.
terms.changesContent: These terms may be updated. In case of significant changes, you will be notified by email or notification. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.contactContent: For any questions about these terms, contact us at: contact@tekizz.com.
